planning: Reproduce the pinned source behavior with server-owned scheduling and tenant-scoped commands.
Characterize FS/SS/FF/SF lag/lead, calendars/DST, negative float, baselines, resources, risk and stale-safe undo where relevant.
Verify keyboard, touch, RTL, export and failure recovery for each affected surface; retain measured budgets.
master_data: Preserve canonical identity, aliases, relationships, custom fields, lifecycle and source lineage relevant to this entry.
Reject unauthorized/cross-tenant writes; reconcile imports, duplicates, rollback and downstream links.
commercial: Characterize the full requisition/quote/contract or sales outcome using decimal quantities and explicit currency.
Preserve source versions, evidence, separation of review from binding commitment, and deterministic replay.
shipment: Preserve route, milestones, document requirements, inventory references and exception transitions relevant to this entry.
GO/readiness must not silently become shipment, customs, payment or inventory execution.
field_quality: Preserve lot/farm/delivery lineage, sampling units, split/merge balances and original measurements.
Replay offline observations idempotently; surface conflicts, permissions and missing evidence explicitly.
compliance: Version standards and requirements by relevant product/country/context and preserve evidence/reviewer lineage.
Missing, expired or unreviewed evidence must not satisfy readiness or certify a legal outcome.
finance: Use decimal money/quantities with source-dated FX, fees, freight, duties and assumption versions.
Reconcile landed cost, working capital, cashflow and sensitivities; advisory approval must not settle funds.
evidence: Preserve classification, source references, immutable digests, review history and exact subject binding.
Private personal records stay separate; individual business due-diligence records remain restricted business data.
Verify quarantine, promotion, redaction, retention, export and recovery where applicable.
identity: Require authenticated tenant/actor context and fresh server-side permission checks.
Verify lifecycle, revocation, scoped partner access and negative cross-tenant/cross-role cases.
workflow: Use one owner per task, approval and retry lifecycle, with bounded idempotent transitions.
Preserve assignment, escalation, cancellation, evidence and recovery relevant to the source behavior.
agents: Resolve source/target ownership before execution; one scheduler advances each run.
Preserve risk tiers, independent approval, evaluation, memory review, budgets, leases and receipts.
Agent output never grants permission; deny unknown classification and cross-tenant or stale commands.
communications: External communications system remains authoritative for content, membership, calls and delivery.
Qualify UOK object links with independent authorization, short-lived scope, receipt-backed delivery and degraded operation.
Preserve each listed communication behavior; legacy whiteboards use one chosen canvas authority.
canvas: Use one authoritative convergence engine with per-property merge, scope isolation and bounded operations.
Prove concurrent edits, offline replay, snapshot/restart recovery, authorization and accessible editing/export.
local_files: Keep local desktop work behind an explicitly scoped companion contract with no server filesystem access.
Preserve read-only behavior and local privacy; migration does not activate deletion or cleanup.
Any future cleanup requires a separate ownership/security decision, exact identity revalidation and reversible recovery.
reporting: Preserve filters, grain, source permissions, freshness, reconciliation and each declared artifact format.
Verify report/export accuracy and spreadsheet-safe cells; do not create shadow business authority.
publication: Publish only reviewed/redacted snapshots and validate public intake as pending review.
Prove tenant/private-content exclusion and controlled publication withdrawal.
platform: Preserve module-neutral navigation, installation lifecycle and shared usability behavior relevant to this entry.
Prove disabled-module behavior, capability-based controls, accessibility and stale-request containment.
